{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling commas
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Verify the conversion
print("Revenue type after conversion:")
print(sales_df['revenue'].dtype)

# Check for any non-numeric values in revenue
print("Any non-numeric revenue values?")
print(sales_df['revenue'].apply(lambda x: isinstance(x, (int, float))).all())

# Check that converted is binary
print("Converted values:")
print(sales_df['converted'].value_counts())"}
